{{CorrectTitle|title=l'Quar'ta}}
'''l'Quar'ta''' was one of the sixteen continents in [[Guiteica/Legends|Guiteica]]. It was to the south-east of the [[Upper Bal'ta'ran Cluster]].

It was famous as the base of the [[m'Yalfor'ac Order]].
